text_block_list.text:
The second leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Nippon Derby.
Today at Tokyo Racecourse,
Narita Brian takes to the track.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's still morning, you know.
Just as Narita Brian said, a massive crowd had already packed the venue.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think is gonna win?
In this year's Derby, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
There's only one choice. It's gotta be Narita Brian.
Anyone who saw that Satsuki Sho would think the same.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya... If I were an Umamusume,
I'd want no part of a Classic year with a monster like that around.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You can tell just by watching how insane it is.
It's only natural to get cold feet... Some might even withdraw.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What does this mean...? What in the world are the spectators saying...?
That just goes to show how immense of an impact her performance in the Satsuki Sho truly made.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you see that?
She was an absolute monster on the final stretch!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"You mean Brian? I wonder if she's running the Derby?
I just messaged my Trainer to ask about it."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text: "Haaah... Narita Brian, huh..."
Enough to make even the Umamusume themselves say as much...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do not be swayed by the noise.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Where is this place we find ourselves in?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Right... this is the place you brought me to.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Have more confidence in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The way of running you taught me
brought me a joy like never before.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The path to the Classic Triple Crown that you showed me
made me want to run with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What is there to fret over?
There's nothing at all, is there?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It is time to head to the paddock.
I shall take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I really am leaving, you know.
Don't you have anything to say?"
choice_data_list: Go and run with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hah, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, what kind of run will she show us today?!
Here comes Narita Brian!
(Wooooo--!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...It's finally here. My stage with that person.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...I definitely won't lose. That's why
Trainer put me through all that special training, after all."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text:
...I will definitely win...!
No matter who I'm up against... I will...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (Yes, just as they say.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Once you step onto this stage, hearts become one.
All we desire is victory... it is as simple as that.)
